sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Wind Release, Fire Release

system.description:
You create motes of superheated flame that circle around you before being fired like missiles towards a target within range. Make a ranged Ninjutsu attack, dealing 4d6 fire damage and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, Gaining 1 rank of Burned on a failed save.

Scorch. By spending 1 Scorch Charge, this attack becomes explosive and murderous. On a hit, the affected creature takes their damage as normal, but now, all creatures within 10 feet of the original target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking this jutsu’s original damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails their saving throw by 5 or more, also gains 1 rank of Burned.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage of this jutsu by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of creatures you can target with this jutsu by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the number of creatures you can target with this jutsu by +1.
